jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Consultant
jobs.description:
CenterPoint Energy and its predecessor companies have been in business for more than 150 years.

Our Vision: Our vision is to become the most admired utility in the United States through the execution of our long-term growth strategy. We have an unwavering commitment to safely and reliably deliver electricity and natural gas to millions of people.

Our Commitment: CenterPoint Energy is committed to creating an inclusive work environment where business results are achieved through the skills, abilities and talents of our diverse workforce.

At CenterPoint Energy, individuals are respected for their contributions toward our company objectives. We strive for an inclusive work environment across all levels that is reflective of the available workforce in the communities we serve.

Job Summary

With limited supervision, the Continuous Improvement Consultant identifies, plans, participates in, and facilitates Lean Continuous Improvement projects and activities that align with the organization’s enterprise-level strategic initiatives around revenue, cost, quality and service. The consultant is responsible to learn business processes in a wide range of organizational areas and to use structured process improvement and problem-solving methods that will add sustainable value, as well as aid the business in implementing various lean practices such as visual management, standard work, streamlined workflows, daily improvements, and end-to-end process optimization projects. The consultant can lead any business unit functional area. The consultant works cooperatively with cross functional teams and departments to seek improvements and solve specific problems along with aiding in defining and delivering the value proposition. The consultant is capable of pro-actively building on prior projects to identify and extend improvements in related areas.

Essential Functions

•Understand the corporate strategic plan to assist in evaluation and determination of improvement opportunities.
•Facilitate cross-functional teams to create standardized processes and implement continuous improvement in support of business unit plans.
•Be a change agent and champion of a continuous improvement culture focused on waste elimination across the organization using lean methods, processes, and tools, such as 5S, Kaizen, Value Stream Analysis, Structured Problem Solving, etc.
•Work with the business to develop and implement high level and detailed key performance indicators.
•Teach others to develop reliable measurement methods and communications tools to report results.
•Ensure accuracy and integrity of data produced and results reported; accept accountability and work cohesively in a team environment that stresses attention to detail.
•Develop project charters for process improvement efforts including defining project requirements, scope, baseline metrics, resources, team members, deliverables, and project and task owners.
•Develop financial acumen to ensure priority actions are focused on driving the right improvements in the business, impacting the bottom line.
•Perform financial and cost-benefit analyses using a wide variety of analytical tools and methods.
•Support the implementation of visual management and processes for regular review.
•Facilitate efforts to re-design processes and procedures demonstrating advanced analytical skills and creative solution planning.
•May be called upon to provide training to other staff members in the use of data, statistics, performance improvement tools and problem-solving processes.
•Present team outcomes to peers and management for review, comment, and approval, overcoming barriers and addressing concerns.
•Perform periodic “go and see” activities and data collection for the purposes of understanding improvement opportunities in designated area.
•Develop business cases and project plans using company standards.
•Demonstrate excellent business acumen in communications, behavior, dependability, and teamwork.
•Continually work with leadership to ensure continual progress is being made in all production areas to affect lean systems and culture.
•Ensure 30, 60, 90-day Kaizen reviews are proactive and completed in a timely manner.
•Manage schedules and provide updates assuming multiple concurrent assignments.
•Regularly develop and add to own skills.
•Teach colleagues to competently apply Lean continuous improvement methods and principles as a trusted business resource.
•Lead and contribute to continuously improving tools and methods utilized by Continuous Improvement.

Education Description

Bachelor’s degree required, engineering, operations research, business, finance, technology or organizational management preferred. Others accepted.

Experience

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

- Minimum 2 years in lean methodologies, process improvement, project management, financial analytics, agile and/or relevant experience in utility industry

We want you to know
Being a part of the CenterPoint Energy team is more than a career alone. It's an opportunity to make a positive impact. You will be an integral part of enabling everyday life and the pursuit of possibilities for the customers we serve and the communities we share. The vital services we provide are at the core of making our world work, and by sharing your energy with us, we'll create a better tomorrow together.

What we bring to you

- Competitive pay

- Paid training

- Benefits eligibility begins on your first day

- Transit subsidies

- Access to discounts at fitness clubs and an on-site wellness center at our headquarters in Houston

- Professional growth and development programs including tuition reimbursement

The Manager, Enterprise Materials Procurement is responsible for strategically leading category management, sourcing direction, supplier relationship management, and long-term procurement planning across Enterprise Materials categories supporting CenterPoint Energy's Electric and Gas Operations. This role provides oversight for critical utility material categories, including but not limited to Meters & Regulators, Maintenance, Repair & Operations (MRO), Safety Supplies, Gas Material Distribution, Electric Material Distribution, and Gas Pipe Support. The manager partners closely with key business stakeholders to ensure the supply base can reliably support enterprise objectives, system reliability, growth programs, emergency response, and day-to-day operations using appropriate metrics and benchmarking. jobs.description:

Job Summary

The Lead Analyst of Insurance Risk Management (IRM) is responsible for analyzing, implementing, and supporting a comprehensive, enterprise‑wide corporate insurance and surety program that proactively connects risk and opportunity with performance. The role focuses on identification of risk exposures, evaluation of appropriate risk management solutions and application of conventional risk transfer, risk retention and/or alternative risk transfer, while aligning risk management practices with corporate strategy and policies. This role will report to the Manager of Insurance Risk Management.

Essential Functions

- Design, implement, and continuously mature a holistic, enterprise-wide corporate insurance and surety program that aligns with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations, and leading practices in risk governance.

- Facilitate insurance renewals through execution of strategy predicated on risk identification, evaluation, and application of conventional risk transfer, risk retention and/or alternative risk transfer.

- Prepare renewal presentations, schedule and coordinate meetings with insurance brokers and underwriters.

- Develop and track renewal timelines, tasks to promote progress, and generate leadership renewal recommendations.

- Facilitate cross‑functional engagement with key stakeholders to compile and review renewal submissions.

- Track, review and electronically file insurance binders, policies, and supplemental renewal documentation.

- Support certain claims processes through coordination with claims, litigation and various subject matter experts to compile and submit deliverables for favorable resolution.

- Establish ongoing monitoring and reporting processes that provide leadership with a consolidated, enterprise‑wide view of risk exposure and trends (e.g., dashboard, quarterly memos, total cost of risk, peer benchmarking analysis).

- Provide shared-service solutions such as contractual insurance provision reviews, establishing surety bonds and certificates of insurance.

Essential Functions Continued

- Coordinate with team members to produce a timely and accurate production of annual plan, monthly forecasts, cash forecasting, invoice allocations and any financial information required for regulatory filings to meet stakeholder requirements.

- Perform variance analysis and ad-hoc reports as needed to support in operational decisions.

- Facilitate broker requests for proposals and manage ongoing broker relationships, including performance, service delivery, communication, and accountability.

- Support administrative needs associated with the company’s captive insurance program  and various high-deductible programs (e.g., monthly workers’ compensation billing allocation, collaboration with third party administration).

- Support special projects, mergers and acquisitions and legislative session insurance needs on an as-needed basis.

- Identify and propose efficiency-gain solutions to streamline workflows leveraging approved artificial intelligence solutions, Microsoft Office Suite, intranet, etc.

- Organize annual electric, gas and property loss control site visits and follow-up meetings.

- Support executive leadership and board‑level engagement through forward‑looking risk reporting, clear articulation of risk trade‑offs, and insights on emerging market trends.

- Proactively communicate in a clear, decision‑oriented manner that enables timely and informed leadership action.

- Partner with leaders across finance, treasury, operations, legal, compliance, and other functions to fully analyze strategies that challenge the status quo.

Education Description

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Risk Management, or related field.

- Professional certifications in risk management are a plus.

Experience

- 3 - 8+ years of progressive experience in insurance risk management.

- Proven contractual insurance provision review experience.

- Proven track record with executive-level reporting and stakeholder engagement.

- Experience supporting ISN vendor compliance platform a plus.

- Experience with third-party administrator claims portals preferred.

jobs.description:
CenterPoint Energy and its predecessor companies have been in business for more than 150 years.

Our Vision: Our vision is to become the most admired utility in the United States through the execution of our long-term growth strategy. We have an unwavering commitment to safely and reliably deliver electricity and natural gas to millions of people.

Our Commitment: CenterPoint Energy is committed to creating an inclusive work environment where business results are achieved through the skills, abilities and talents of our diverse workforce.

At CenterPoint Energy, individuals are respected for their contributions toward our company objectives. We strive for an inclusive work environment across all levels that is reflective of the available workforce in the communities we serve.

Job Summary

Provides senior-level technical leadership and hands-on expertise for the digital enablement of Supply Chain, driving adoption and optimization of digital procurement platforms, including Coupa, SAP S/4HANA, and Ariba, across the procure-to-pay (P2P) lifecycle. As an individual contributor, serves as a functional lead, solution owner, and trusted advisor for system administration, process enablement, automation, data governance, analytics, and Agentic AI. Contributes to CenterPoint Energy’s Velocity S/4HANA transformation by helping design, configure, test, and deploy scalable digital solutions that support efficient, compliant, and data-driven buying behavior. Accountable for assigned enablement outcomes, solution performance, process standardization, adoption, and continuous improvement across Supply Chain.

Essential Functions

•    Provides functional leadership, configuration expertise, and continuous-improvement support for digital procurement systems, including Coupa, SAP S/4HANA, and Ariba, to enable efficient and compliant end-to-end P2P processes.
•    Serves as a Supply Chain functional lead and platform subject-matter expert for procurement technologies, supporting solution design, system administration, master data integrity, user access, integrations, and platform governance.
•    Partners with the Velocity S/4HANA transformation program to design, test, and deploy future-state Supply Chain processes using clean-core and fit-to-standard principles, while supporting business readiness and adoption.
•    Identifies, designs, and implements process automation and digitization opportunities that reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, improve the user experience, and embed preventive or detective controls into buying processes.
•    Leads the evaluation and responsible application of Agentic AI within Supply Chain, including identifying use cases, defining human-in-the-loop controls, establishing guardrails, coordinating pilots, monitoring performance, and supporting scalable deployment.
•    Designs and improves AI-enabled workflows and autonomous or semi-autonomous agents that can support activities such as intake, guided buying, supplier and contract information retrieval, exception triage, analytics, and workflow orchestration, subject to approved governance and security requirements.
•    Partners with IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Risk, Internal Controls, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to ensure AI and automation solutions comply with enterprise architecture, privacy, data protection, model-risk, records-management, and responsible-AI expectations.
•    Develops Supply Chain analytics, dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, adoption metrics, and process-performance models that support sourcing, spend management, compliance, and operational decision-making.
•    Establishes and maintains procurement data-governance standards to improve data accuracy, consistency, ownership, lineage, quality, and appropriate use across systems, reporting, automation, and AI solutions.

Essential Functions Continued

•    Bridges the gap between future-state P2P design and day-to-day execution by standardizing processes, resolving root causes, reducing rework, and supporting remediation of control or audit observations.
•    Maintains digital enablement policies, procedures, standard work instructions, training materials, knowledge content, Supply Chain intranet content, and supplier-portal content within assigned areas.
•    Partners with IT, Finance, internal stakeholders, and external vendors or contractors to gather requirements, define priorities, manage product backlogs, coordinate releases, conduct testing, and support organizational change management.
•    Ensures digital procurement processes and configurations align with purchasing policies, delegated authorities, internal controls, and SOX requirements.
•    Provides technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge transfer to employees, contractors, process owners, and system users without direct people-management accountability.

Education Description

•    Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, information systems, computer science, engineering, data science, or a related discipline required.
•    Advanced degree in a relevant discipline preferred.

Experience

•    6+ years of relevant experience in supply chain, procurement, digital procurement enablement, enterprise systems, process automation, or a related field.
•    Demonstrated hands-on experience administering, configuring, implementing, or supporting digital procurement platforms such as Coupa, SAP S/4HANA, and/or SAP Ariba.
•    Strong knowledge of ERP and P2P system functionality, solution design, integration, testing, release management, adoption, and             operational support.

•    Demonstrated experience with procurement analytics, reporting, data governance, process design, controls, and continuous                     improvement.
•    Experience supporting a large-scale ERP, digital, or operating-model transformation, preferably involving SAP S/4HANA.
•    Practical experience evaluating, designing, piloting, implementing, or governing Agentic AI solutions, AI agents, copilots, or intelligent         workflow automation in an enterprise environment.
•    Experience translating business problems into AI or automation use cases, requirements, process designs, acceptance criteria, control requirements, and measurable outcomes.
•    Experience with prompt design, agent instructions, tools or connectors, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow orchestration, model evaluation, monitoring, and human-in-the-loop exception handling preferred.
•    Experience applying responsible-AI, cybersecurity, privacy, data-governance, and change-management principles to enterprise AI solutions preferred.
•    Supply chain or procurement-specific AI experience strongly preferred.

Preferred Certifications:

•    Coupa and/or SAP certification (S/4HANA or Ariba).
•    Recognized AI, generative AI, machine learning, data, automation, cloud, or responsible-AI certification.
•    Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile, Scrum, or product-management certification.
•    Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) and/or APICS CPIM/CSCP certification.
•    Lean Six Sigma or business-process-management certification.

Job Summary

The Senior Procurement Specialist is responsible for leading strategic sourcing and procurement activities supporting Engineering & Construction Services within the Utility Procurement department. This role partners closely with internal stakeholders to develop sourcing strategies, execute complex procurement initiatives, negotiate contracts, manage supplier relationships, and drive value through cost optimization, risk mitigation, and operational excellence.

The position serves as a trusted advisor to business partners and provides leadership on procurement best practices, supplier strategy, market intelligence, and contract management. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating independently, influencing stakeholders, and managing multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.

Essential Functions

•    Lead sourcing strategies and competitive procurement events for engineering, construction, and professional service categories.
•    Negotiate contracts, pricing, commercial terms, and risk provisions with suppliers.
•    Develop and manage strategic supplier relationships to support operational and capital project objectives.
•    Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and develop procurement solutions aligned with company goals.
•    Identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, supplier consolidation, and risk reduction.
•    Manage contract lifecycle activities including amendments, renewals, funding strategies, and performance monitoring.
•    Support large capital projects by providing procurement guidance and ensuring timely execution of sourcing activities.
•    Analyze spend data, market trends, supplier capabilities, and industry developments to inform procurement strategies.
